topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I noticed my car was missing, which was quite surprising since I had parked it in my driveway just this morning. After a moment of confusion, I observed the little ticket that had been tucked under my mailbox—it explained that the car had been towed. The ticket detailed a violation I wasn’t aware of, something about a temporary no-parking sign for utility work. I decided the best course of action was to gather all the information from the ticket, including the tow lot number and contact information. Then, I called the number to understand what steps I needed to take to retrieve my car. It’s a bit of an inconvenience, but it’s just a matter of following through with the necessary procedures now.
